proposed_g_decisions.question: What does shared polisyos.canon.json@0.2.0 identity mean across Core and IR?
proposed_g_decisions.recommendation: Shared canonical mechanics/settings only; retain contextual strict Core and IR tag allowlists. Matching name/version does not make every Core tag portable to IR.
alternatives: Add a persisted tag-family selector only if G defines schema, identity/hash consequences, reader/writer compatibility, versioned migration and old-reference behavior.
Do not widen IR tags or change stored bytes by implication of the shared profile name.
proposed_g_decisions.discriminator: Core FileSystemCAS writes a Core-only tagged value; a fresh Core reader accepts while IR refuses the same bytes. This is a control, not a claim about all producers.

proposed_g_decisions.question: How to interpret historical JSON artifacts with no persisted profile?
proposed_g_decisions.recommendation: Refuse semantic interpretation when profile identity is absent; preserve exact raw representation under existing tenant/integrity/surface checks and the scoped candidate-only Ukraine snapshot.
alternatives: A legacy semantic path needs a named owner and actual versioned provenance/custody evidence: exact store/ref, bytes and manifest digests, historical encoding provenance, audience/use/status/time, custody/reissue basis. Do not infer from valid JSON, labels, hashes or reader defaults.
Keep absent, malformed-present, unknown/unsupported, declared and conformant distinct.
proposed_g_decisions.discriminator: Absent and malformed-present controls remain distinct; raw bytes are exact while semantic interpretation refuses absent profile.
